help.title: About the reference date
help.body:
This is not a filter on the courses. All courses are always displayed. It is a filter that only changes the numbers in the table's "Occupancy" column.
Students may be enrolled in or unenrolled from a course during the season, so this filter is here to give the headcount of the courses as of a specific date. This provides a kind of "history" of course headcounts. By default, the selected date is the day before the current day, so that you see the current student headcount.

For example, consider the following case:
there are 3 students in a course on 10/04/2022 and one of the students leaves the course on 11/04/2022.
If the filter is set to 12/04/2022 or later, the occupancy of this course will be 2, whereas if the filter is set to 11/04/2022 or earlier, the occupancy will be 3.
